responses:
I checked this against the only tender in the repo, `tenders/T-2026-014/tender.md`. **The IP66 offer meets the requirement, but the extraction has the wrong citation and leaves out part of the scope.**

| # | Finding | Source (doc / clause) | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---------|-----------------------|---------------|--------------------|--------|
| 1 | IP65 or better is required | Extraction says "RFQ p.3 §2.1, 'Enclosures shall be IP65 or better.'" No such clause exists in T-2026-014. The real clause is **§4.5** (`tender.md:25`): *"Panel and motor terminal enclosures shall be IP65 or better."* | APPLIES | §9 (Special conditions, which override §4 and §7 under §9.3) has no IP override. | **CONTRADICTED** (wrong citation and wording) |
| 2 | Applies to all panels | §4.5 | APPLIES, but to **panels and motor terminal enclosures**, not only panels | Same as #1 | **CONTRADICTED** (scope too narrow) |
| 3 | IP66 meets IP65 | IEC 60529. For the second digit up to 6, a rating also covers the lower levels, so IPX6 covers IPX5. The first digit is 6 in both. | APPLIES | None | **VERIFIED**, provided IP66 is offered for motor terminal boxes too |

**Points to check:**
- **Is this the right document?** "p.3 §2.1" doesn't match anything in T-2026-014. If you meant a different RFQ, send it and I'll check against that. Otherwise the citation needs correcting to §4.5.
- **Motor terminal boxes are missing.** The offer has to show IP65 or better for the terminal boxes on P-01 and P-02, not just the panels.
- **The P-01 terminal box has a second requirement.** P-01 sits in the wet well, which is Zone 1 (Annex B). Under §4.3 its motor must be ATEX Ex d certified, so that terminal box needs both Ex d and IP65 or better. Check that the datasheet shows both ratings.
- **50 °C ambient (§9.2).** This doesn't change the IP rating. But the IP66 rating and any internal heat calculations for the panels should hold at 50 °C. Worth checking against the datasheet.

**Counts:** 1 verified, 2 contradicted, 0 unsupported, 0 needing a person's judgement. Missing from the extraction: motor terminal enclosures (§4.5) and the Ex d requirement for the P-01 terminal box (§4.3).

**No-go as written.** Fix the citation to §4.5, extend the scope to motor terminal enclosures, and confirm IP66 on the motor terminal boxes and Ex d on the P-01 box. After that the IP66 offer is compliant.
